metadata.title: Observation Bandwidth, Reobservation, and Causal Order: A Falsifiable Experimental Program Derived from the QIK-VRT Computational Architecture
metadata.description: A preregistration-oriented experimental program that derives five falsifiable engineering, causal-order, and physical-bridge hypotheses from a bounded QIK-VRT computational system test while preserving the boundary between repository evidence and physical evidence.
metadata.notes: Candidate metadata only. No DOI exists unless a successful Zenodo deposit is independently observed. Active hypotheses are PROPOSED_NOT_EXECUTED.
